items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: I got in the chamelea band playing piano. And after Wooden Joe got off the trumpet... I replaced him on trumpet.

ctx.x: When you started on piano, did you have a piano at home to practice on? Take lessons?

No, I was just taking piano, you know, by going by different people's house like that. And I learned how to play the couple of numbers. And well piano players would skates then, they'd get jammed for parties, they would hire me, you know. And that's how I came out to the light. And after I got with them, well I got to follow music, and in later years, in 1927, 1928 like that, I'd taken to trumpet. Well I learned how to play trumpet a pretty good while. To back up and get some of these different guys' names and instruments. Johnny Prudence was playing with Kit Howard, you say?
